story: A three-rider breakaway formed early in Stage 1 of the 2026 Tour of Guangxi, but the peloton, controlled by Soudal Quick-Step, Red Bull-BORA-hansgrohe and Decathlon CMA CGM, brought the escapees back with 10 kilometres remaining. Soudal Quick-Step executed a perfectly timed sprint lead-out, moving three riders to the front just before the final kilometre. Laurenz Rex delivered an excellent final lead-out, allowing Paul Magnier to claim victory in the bunch sprint.
